title: What's the best place to talk about AI merged games like SKATE x WoW? I have a request.
author: Green_Blue_Grey_
selftext:
I have a very specific wish for a long time now and since I cannot do it myself I wanted to ask around if someone could help, as AI decompiling is becoming popular. 

Extracting the DiRT Rally 2.0 physics or overall engine so it can be merged with other games.  
  
Not only I would love to ride around in WoW like some guys do with Skate, but I have this little dream of having a fully playable campaign of the Trackmania 2 set (Stadium, Valley and Lagoon) with rally cars. Especially the 205 Turbo 16 and the Polo WRX.

Might not work with default cars speed to go across the giant gaps and loopings but I'm sure it can be tweaked somehow.

If you guys can show me a direction I'll take it.

Cheers.

comments.author: Fuzzzy420
comments.body:
Try openAI or Claude.com 
Install the game and point the ai to the folder

comments.author: Rybergx
comments.body: Not sure where to talk about it. But watch YouTube tutorials and I would just converse with your ai on how to do it. And be specific because it’ll try to steer you in a different “easier” direction

comments.author: Toastti
comments.body: Why can't you do it yourself? Download both those games and give this whole post to Claude code. It will figure it out you just need to iterate and test

replies.author: Green_Blue_Grey_
replies.body: Maybe I'll do it in the future when I have the budget for it, that's why. So far I'm funneling money elsewhere, or using my current usage limits for priority work.

comments.author: Ok-Skin-3699
comments.body: So, you're probably looking to make a "passthrough" mod here, using the engine and physics of DR2 and the level data of trackmania, look up the passthrough mod git and ask claude to explain it to you if youre interested.
